name: Brickbeam
description:
Building a brick set and can't find that one piece in the pile? brickbeam helps kids (and grown-ups)
find the exact pieces a set still needs — just point the camera.

• Scan a single piece or a whole pile — AI finds and identifies the bricks, then tells you which
  ones your set still needs (green = needed).
• Track several builds at once. Pick a set, and brickbeam lists every piece with a live progress bar.
• Find building instructions for your set.
• Works offline: download the set catalog once and search without limits.
• Turkish and English — switches automatically to your phone's language, and you can change it
  any time from the home screen.
• Made for ages 7–15: big buttons, clear steps, friendly guidance. No ads, no accounts, no tracking.
author: Muhammet Şahin
